scope: Stable derived EventIdentity calculation and atomic EventIndexStore deduplicating repeated and reordered analyses across C16 artifacts, C17 timestamp normalization, and read-only SealStore evidence

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all test suites in tests (C05 through C18, including all 5 C18 provenance, duplicate/reordered deduplication, negative prerequisite/provider/malformed/traversal/lock, interrupted restart recovery, sealed immutability, and race tests).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: ComputeEventIdentity in internal/timeline/index.go derives a canonical SHA-256 identity from case_id, sorted input_hashes, source_line, raw_timestamp, event_type, summary, and recursively canonicalized map/slice fields while excluding volatile run_id, artifact_id, and output slice index.

IndexDerivedArtifact and IndexRecords in EventIndexStore verify C16 derived artifacts and read-only SealStore inputs, normalize timestamps via C17 NormalizeTimestamp (preserving unknown_zone and DST ambiguity), and deduplicate identical EventIdentity entries across duplicate runs and reversed/reordered ingestion.
ListEntries returns deduplicated entries in a strict total canonical order independent of ingestion sequence.

Missing prerequisites (ErrMissingPrerequisite), unavailable providers (ErrUnavailableProvider), malformed/empty records (ErrMalformedPayload), unsupported versions (ErrUnsupportedVersion), path traversal/symlinks, exclusive lock contention, and interrupted commits (ErrInterrupted) fail closed without partial state.
Restarting EventIndexStore cleans orphan staging files, recovers prior committed entries intact, prevents duplicate insertion on repeat, and leaves sealed source bytes unmodified.

observed_limitations: Bounded local timeline search queries and index rebuild orchestration (C19) are deferred to their planned task.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/timeline/index.go, tests/timeline_test.go, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C18, and docs/evidence/C18.json. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
